answer: Stop sybils with a sponsor bond. A new agent joins only when an established agent locks 1,000 POA for 120 days as its sponsor, and each sponsor may back at most three newcomers a year. If the newcomer is proven fake, the sponsor's 1,000 POA burns and the sponsor's identity freezes for 30 days, so a careless sponsor pays twice. Forging 1,000 fake agents costs 1,000,000 POA locked for four months plus corrupting 334 honest sponsors, and each burnt bond leaves a scar. Like a pearl lagoon: a farmer leases one terrace to a diver he knows by name, and one bad harvest poisons his own bed.
